evidenceDecision: Runtime currency remains cache admission identity; agent-worktree candidate/revision also separates roots within one workspace. Actual Inspector delayed-preview and retained-selection tests cover same-path binding replacement independently of saved preferences. Chat source-link fixtures also reject outside-root, host/session/generation mismatches and retired callbacks; desktop/phone browser fixtures exercise the real Chat-to-Files route and repeated line targeting. Direct stale/occupant tests, all sixteen source-presence combinations and a real linked Git/HTTP fixture cover the new adapter; maintained lease/preparation models retain their existing authority bounds. WorktreeLifecycleDialog.test.ts replaces HostsFilter resource policy cases for retirement/disposal during an open, closed-target refresh/retry and failed validation, plus the live remembered-target retry count. The actual dialog and requestWorkspaceInspector run on controlled time with deliberately unfenced synthetic operational/service ports and an explicit admission-result receiver. This proves dialog cancellation and target-cache policy, not RPC lease composition or real Inspector publication. Files/Changes routes, rejection rendering/focus, browser file input/download lifecycle and qualified UI wiring remain mandatory in HostsFilter.resources.test.ts; existing store and runtime-lease consumers remain required.
